it is impossible to tease out the effects of frequency from volume in this study. Whether simply performing longer durations during a single session would confer similar benefits to spreading out frequency over the course of a week has not yet been determined. That said, a hypothetical case can be made that lower-duration, higher-intensity aerobic training performed more frequently would help to optimize hypertrophic adaptations.
